entries.0afc503569d02acc: This business provides fee-based placement services that refer people with specialized skills, such as designers, creators and engineers in the CG, game production, video production and WEB production industries, to client companies, and temporary staffing services that dispatch registered temporary workers. It operates the registration site 'Silicon Studio Agent' and the staffing-dedicated site 'Silicon Studio Staff'; as of November 30, 2025, the number of registrants was approximately 30,000. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥1,641 million.
entries.23c1d7a792f1af1c: CG, video and WEB production companies
entries.3eeb3c8fc5e00ed0: This business provides solutions centered on 3DCG and rendering technologies for the entertainment industry, including games and video, as well as for the automotive, architecture, space, defense and other manufacturing industries. It also develops and sells middleware for home game consoles, smartphones and embedded devices, provides infrastructure services such as building, operating and monitoring server networks, and provides pre-rendered movies. Its head office is located in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥2,661 million.
entries.4b1f73e600696cb9: This category provides one-stop services for server programs and network systems for online games, from consulting and design to development and 24-hour, 365-day operation. It also designs and builds CG rendering pipelines for the video industry. No separate amount is disclosed.
entries.b56e5013ef6cdc38: A company centered on 3DCG technology that develops middleware and provides contract development for the game and video industries, and offers staffing and recruitment services specialized in creators.
entries.c74fa03b6f0d8245: This category covers licensing and customization development of the company's in-house middleware for home game consoles, PCs, smartphones and embedded devices. It provides products including 'Enlighten', a global illumination product; 'YEBIS', a post-effect product; and 'Bone Dynamics', a plugin for physics simulation of jiggling objects compatible with Unreal Engine. No separate amount is disclosed.
entries.c87cdb02bfec5f55: Industrial companies in the automotive and manufacturing sectors
entries.c9560f8ddc53523f: Industrial companies in the automotive, construction and manufacturing sectors
entries.e4f51987234579fb: This category covers contract development using the company's in-house middleware. It provides, to both the entertainment industry and industrial sectors, 3DCG image generation for AI and machine learning, visualization solutions using Unreal Engine and Unity, digital twin construction support, and game development environment construction support, among others. No separate amount is disclosed.
